1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste; and a solvent.

2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface selected from the group consisting of a silicon chip and a microelectronic component.

3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the solvent is selected from the group consisting of ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87. 

9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

11 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste.

12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 μm in size.

13 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 μm in size.

14 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 μm in size.
